articles.summary: Expanded portfolio enables partners to combine HPE infrastructure and networking solutions through a single distributor. TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) today announced it now offers the full HPE portfolio, including HPE Networking, across 37+ countries, territories and regions where it distributes HPE, providing partners with a consistent portfolio across geographies. Building on TD SYNNEX’s selection as one of HPE’s two global distribution partners earlier this year, the authorization further unifies the company’s global reach, giving partners more consistent access to and support for HPE technologies for hybrid cloud, compute, storage and networking across markets. “Bringing the full HPE portfolio together across our global reach is an important step in helping partners take advantage of everything HPE has to offer,” said Sergio Farache, chief strategy and technology officer, TD SYNNEX. “Whether they’re adding networking to an existing HPE practice or bringing compute and hybrid IT solutions
articles.title: TD SYNNEX Extends Full HPE Portfolio to Partners Across 37+ Countries, Territories and Regions

articles.summary: TD SYNNEX also honored by Microsoft with multiple regional awards celebrating innovative business outcomes TD SYNNEX (NYSE:SNX) today announced it has won the Global Commercial Device Channel 2026 Microsoft Partner of the Year Award. articles.summary: Fifth annual Direction of Technology Report finds 66% of IT partners accelerating AI investment, but only 21% generating meaningful revenue from it TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) today released its fifth annual Direction of Technology (DoT) Report , revealing a significant gap between technology investment and realized value in the technology channel. The report found that while 66% of partners are accelerating investment in AI solutions and services, only 21% derive a meaningful share of revenue from those investments – a 45-point investment-to-revenue gap, the largest among the technologies studied. Based on insights from more than 1,500 channel partners (SMB technology resellers) across 45 countries, the report highlights the growing challenge of turning investments into measurable business outcomes. articles.title: TD SYNNEX Report: AI Spending Is Surging, but Revenue Isn’t Keeping Pace

articles.summary: Combining Destination AI™ for SMBs with Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Fabric and the Microsoft Cloud gives partners a connected path from AI opportunity discovery through proof of value and deployment, on display at Microsoft Ignite Booth #2032. TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) today announced how its Destination AI™ for SMBs framework helps Microsoft partners identify AI opportunities, demonstrate value and grow their AI practices. Building on the SMB-focused capabilities TD SYNNEX introduced in October, the offering brings TD SYNNEX resources together with Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Fabric and the broader Microsoft Cloud, so partners can apply AI to the applications, data and business processes their customers already rely on.
